extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants (PD/PI, senior/key personnel) and institutional grant administrators preparing PHS 398 biosketches and cover page supplements
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing NIH PHS 398 biographical sketch sections and Cover Page Supplement/Modular Budget sections for PD/PI and senior/key personnel, following the required fields, yes/no questions, and tabular entries. Includes vertebrate animals, program income, hESC, HFT, inventions, change-of-PI, and modular budget reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH — format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The biosketch must follow the specified format and length (max five pages). Include the standard labeled sections (A. Personal Statement; Education/Training table; Positions and Scientific Appointments; Professional Memberships; Honors and Other Professional Activities; C. Contributions to Science; links to complete publication lists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement — text describing the applicant's suitability and qualifications to collaborate on the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how your training, temperament, and specific expertise make you able to contribute to the proposed work; cite recent relevant publications or specific technical capabilities. The example shows framing of background, unique approaches, and evidence of capacity to complete the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Institution and location, Degree (if applicable), Completion Date (MM/YYYY), and Field of Study for each training entry. Begin with undergraduate education and include postdoc/residency as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Scientific Appointments — listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Positions and Scientific Appointments — chronological listing of appointments and roles (dates, titles, institution/department).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List employment history (years and titles), visiting/sabbatical appointments, and notable research fellow positions. Include advisors/mentors for training positions when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Memberships and Honors — documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional Memberships; Honors and Other Professional Activities — list membership dates and honors/awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide dates for membership (e.g., 2013–pres.) and list honors (fellowships, awards) and organizing/committee roles. Include relevant teaching and mentoring activities (courses, approximate class sizes if listed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science — structure and content
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Contributions to Science — describe major contributions (numbered items) with brief narrative and supporting citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution, provide a succinct description of the discovery/advance, significance/impact, and 2–4 representative citations (with bibliographic details). The page shows multiple numbered contributions with lettered citations (a., b., c., ...). Include links to complete publication lists as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published works — linking
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a link to a complete list of published works (e.g., MyNCBI or Google Scholar).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant has many publications, include a URL to the complete bibliography (the biosketch itself highlights representative citations in Contributions to Science and links the full list).

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Vertebrate Animals Section
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Vertebrate Animals Section — Are vertebrate animals euthanized? Yes/No. If 'Yes' to euthanasia: Is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines? If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer the yes/no questions and, when euthanasia is used, explicitly state compliance with AVMA guidelines or provide a justification and description of alternative methods if not compliant.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Program Income Section
rubrics_metrics.description: 2. *Program Income Section — *Is program income anticipated during the periods for which the grant support is requested? Yes/No. If you checked 'yes' above (indicating that program income is anticipated), then use the format below to reflect the amount and source(s). Otherwise, leave this section blank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', supply a table with columns: *Budget Period, *Anticipated Amount ($), *Source(s). If 'No', leave section blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) Section
rubrics_metrics.description: 3. Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section — *Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? Yes/No. If the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells, list below the registration number of the specific cell line(s) from the registry. Or, if a specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time, check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer yes/no. If yes, list registry numbers (from NIH hESC registry link) or check the provided box indicating a registry line will be used and provide the cell line identifiers when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Fetal Tissue (HFT) Section
rubrics_metrics.description: 4. Human Fetal Tissue Section — *Does the proposed project involve human fetal tissue obtained from elective abortions? Yes/No. If 'yes' then provide the HFT Compliance Assurance. If 'yes' then provide the HFT Sample IRB Consent Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If involvement of elective-abortion-derived fetal tissue is indicated, attach/complete required HFT Compliance Assurance documentation and include the sample IRB consent form per instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Inventions and Patents Section (Renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: 5. Inventions and Patents Section (Renewal applications) — *Inventions and Patents: Yes/No. If the answer is 'Yes' then please answer the following: *Previously Reported: Yes/No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate whether the project has associated inventions/patents. If yes, state whether they were previously reported and supply additional details as required by renewal guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Change of Investigator/Change of Institution Section
rubrics_metrics.description: 6. Change of Investigator/Change of Institution Section — Change of Project Director/Principal Investigator: Name of former Project Director/Principal Investigator (Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix). Change of Grantee Institution: *Name of former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide identifying information for the former PD/PI and name of the former grantee institution when reporting a change of investigator or institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Modular Budget — budget period and direct cost reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget — For each Budget Period provide Start Date and End Date, and A. Direct Costs: Funds Requested ($), Direct Cost less Consortium Indirect (F&A)*, Consortium Indirect (F&A), Total Direct Costs*.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Direct Costs table for each budget period; include line items for direct costs excluding consortium indirects, consortium indirect amount, and calculate total direct costs. Follow the specified dates for Budget Period start/end.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Modular Budget — indirect (F&A) costs and cognizant agency info
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget — B. Indirect (F&A) Costs: Indirect (F&A) Type; Indirect (F&A) Rate (%); Indirect (F&A) Base ($); Funds Requested ($). Fields include MTDC and others. Provide Cognizant Agency (Agency Name, POC Name and Phone Number), Email, Indirect (F&A) Rate Agreement Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the indirect cost type and rate, the F&A base (e.g., MTDC), funds requested, and cite the cognizant agency contact and date of the indirect rate agreement. Include total indirect costs calculations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Modular Budget — total direct plus indirect
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget — C. Total Direct and Indirect (F&A) Costs (A + B) — Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum A. Direct Costs and B. Indirect (F&A) Costs to report the combined total funds requested for the budget period.
